subject: LAB-003
check: Repaired runner and export rule: fresh four-step recipe, refusal before commit, and typed text withheld from exports

outcome.detail: 25 tests in 3 suites passed, including 8 refusal shapes and 22 export placements as arguments. The unbound bundled recipe completed four steps with exactly one appUI createItem whose note carries the transform; the new ID was bound in the catalog and export; a same-request retry replayed the first receipt. Transform without a source, transform before import, two imports, no or unknown collection, oversized note, invalid query and a missing bound item were each refused with no commit, no item change, no staged draft and an unchanged catalog. A commit refused by the operation service left no draft and the previous binding. A pre-cancelled run committed nothing. An invented sentinel under secret-shaped, ordinary, new and renamed model-step names, as a field name, nested in JSON, embedded in a lab-written prompt, and in a title, query or transform note was absent from every export, filename, withholding summary and Inspect Model Step result. Bundled recipes exported with nothing withheld.

steps: Run swift test --package-path Packages/LabFeatures --filter ShortcutWorkbench through labr, and again inside the full script/test.sh gate
limitations: In-memory OperationService with GrantAuthorizationPolicy on macOS 27.0 (26A425); no SQLite, UI, Shortcuts app, system authentication or physical mobile device in this check. The -dirty suffix is research's mirror reporting its untracked build symlink; the mirrored sources were exactly commit ed4a1e1.
Supersedes fresh-recipe-failure.json and secret-export-limit.json, which remain as the record of the defects at addbf39-dirty.
The sentinel is invented, never a credential. The rule withholds all typed text, so person-authored recipes export as structure and IDs only.
